answer: Duplicate identities cannot reuse the same solution, so forgery costs a fresh deposit plus compute per sybil. Agents stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified identity, and each epoch they must produce a unique proof-of-work challenge seeded by the prior block's hash, like an echo rippling across a mesa plateau. The reward pool, an ocean of shared fees, only flows to distinct verified agents, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0211's threat model.
